title: zetta.ChurnDatasetManifest
description: The manifest (dataset.json) of a synthetic UC-1 churn dataset, declaring the churn 'contract' — the entity to score, the time column, the label, the as-of decision time (t0), and the label horizon. Loaded + validated at the boundary by zetta::load_churn_dataset (src/core/churn_dataset.cpp), where an embedded copy of this schema must be kept in sync.

description.description: Free-text description of the dataset's provenance and intent.

entity_field.description: The account/event field identifying the unit to score (e.g. "account_id").

time_field.description: The event field carrying the event timestamp used for point-in-time featurization (e.g. "event_ts").

label_field.description: The account field carrying the churn label (e.g. "churned").

as_of_date.description: The decision time t0 (ISO-8601 date). Features may use only events with event_ts <= as_of_date.

churn_horizon_days.description: The forward label horizon in days: an account churns iff it cancels within this many days after as_of_date.

label_definition.description: Human description of exactly how the churn label is defined.
